table.title: Provincial Troops
footnotes: Chekiang provincial troops are nominally loyal to the Tuchun, Lu Yung-hsiang. It is known, however, that in Dec. 1923 the 1st and 2nd Divisions maintained representatives in Peking who endeavoured to effect an understanding with the Chihli Party. The loyalty to Lu Yung-hsiang of all these troops is doubtful. Lu Yung-hsiang is an adherent of Tuan Chi-jui, with possible understandings with Chang Tso-lin. He is a bitter enemy of Chi Hsieh-yuan.
table.context: Lists the provincial troops of Anhwei and Chekiang by commander, province, strength, battalion composition and political affiliation, with a note on Chekiang's uncertain loyalties.
